en.name: Chorizo, smoked and cooked
en.summary: This is chorizo that has been cured, smoked and fully cooked at the factory, then sealed — a ready-to-eat sausage rather than something you cook from raw. Unopened it keeps about 1 year in the cupboard; once the pack is opened it needs the fridge and about 1 month, and it freezes for 6 months.
en.pantry: An unopened, sealed pack keeps about 1 year in a cool, dry cupboard, away from the cooker and out of direct sun. What makes that possible is the combination of curing salts, smoke, cooking and an intact seal — all four, not any one of them. The moment the seal is broken that shelf stability is gone, so never treat an opened pack as a pantry item, and go by the printed date if it falls earlier than a year.
en.fridge: Once opened, refrigerate at 4 °C (40 °F) or below and use within about 1 month. Re-wrap the piece tightly or move it to a sealed box; the cut face dries and darkens quickly in a fridge. It is fully cooked, so it can go straight onto a board, but it is still a ready-to-eat food that should be kept away from raw meat and handled with clean hands and a clean knife.
en.freezer: About 6 months at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. Freeze it in usable chunks, wrapped tight and bagged with the air pressed out. Frozen food stays safe indefinitely at −18 °C; beyond six months the smoke goes flat and the paprika-red fat begins to taste stale. Thawed chorizo is best used in cooking rather than sliced cold.
en.thawing: Thaw in the fridge and use within the opened-pack window. You can also slice it while still part-frozen, which is easier, and drop it straight into a hot pan.
spoilage: Slime or a tacky film on the surface of an opened piece.
A sour, yeasty or rancid smell rather than a smoky, peppery one.
Mould anywhere on a cooked sausage — this one is not meant to carry a bloom.
A pack that is puffy, leaking or has lost its vacuum before opening.
tips: Write the opening date on the pack — the pantry year and the opened month are completely different clocks.
Buy the size you will finish in a month once opened.
Keep unopened packs away from the hob; heat shortens even a shelf-stable product.
Freeze in chunks rather than slices if you mostly cook with it.

faq.q: Does cooked smoked chorizo need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: Not while the pack is sealed — about 1 year in a cool, dry cupboard. After opening it does: 4 °C (40 °F) or below, about a month.

faq.q: How long does chorizo last after opening?
faq.a: About 1 month refrigerated, tightly wrapped. The unopened shelf life does not carry over once the seal is broken.
Yes, about 6 months at −18 °C (0 °F). Use thawed chorizo in cooking rather than on a cold board.

zh.name: 煙燻熟製西班牙臘腸
zh.summary: 這種 chorizo 在工廠裡已經醃漬、煙燻並完全熟製後密封，是即食香腸，不需要你從生的開始煮。未開封放櫥櫃約可放 1 年；一旦拆封就要冷藏，大約 1 個月，冷凍則是 6 個月。
zh.pantry: 未開封的密封包裝放在陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃裡約可放 1 年，請遠離爐火、避免陽光直射。能常溫保存靠的是醃漬鹽、煙燻、熟製與完整封口四件事同時成立，缺一不可。封口一破，這個常溫穩定性就沒了，所以拆封後絕對不要再當櫥櫃食品；若包裝標示日期早於一年，以標示為準。
zh.fridge: 開封後放 4 °C 以下，約 1 個月內用完。把剩下的部分包緊或放進密封盒，切面在冰箱裡乾得快、也很快變深色。它是全熟品，可以直接切上桌，但仍是即食食品，請和生肉分開，並用乾淨的手和乾淨的刀處理。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下品質約可維持 6 個月。切成方便使用的塊狀，包緊、裝袋壓出空氣。−18 °C 下安全性是無限期的；超過半年煙燻香會變平淡，紅椒油脂開始出現陳味。解凍後的臘腸比較適合入菜，不太適合當冷切盤。
zh.thawing: 放冷藏解凍，並在開封後的期限內用完。也可以趁半凍的時候切片，比較好切，切完直接下熱鍋。
spoilage: 開封後的表面發黏、有一層黏膜。
聞起來發酸、有酵母味或油耗味，而不是煙燻胡椒香。
熟製香腸上出現任何霉——這款不該有白霉花。
未開封的包裝脹袋、滲液或真空跑掉。
tips: 在包裝上寫開封日期——未開封的一年和開封後的一個月是兩套完全不同的時鐘。
買你開封後一個月內吃得完的尺寸。
未開封的包裝也別放爐子旁，高溫會縮短常溫品的壽命。
主要拿來入菜的話，冷凍時切塊比切片好。

faq.q: 煙燻熟製 chorizo 需要冷藏嗎？
faq.a: 未開封不用，陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃約 1 年。開封後就要：4 °C 以下，約一個月。

faq.q: chorizo 開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 冷藏並包緊，約 1 個月。未開封的保存期限不會延續到開封之後。

faq.q: 熟製 chorizo 可以冷凍嗎？
faq.a: 可以，−18 °C 下約 6 個月。解凍後建議入菜，不要當冷盤。
